algorithm.title: Intrapartum antibiotic prophylaxis for group B streptococcus (GBS)

cell.label: Positive GBS culture at 35-37 weeks' gestation. Penicillin allergic?
GBS resistant to clindamycin or erythromycin, or sensitivity unknown?
Penicillin G 5 million U load, then 2.5 million U every 4 hours, OR ampicillin 2 g IV load, then 1 g IV every 4 hours until delivery.
Cefazolin 2 g IV initial dose, then 1 g every 8 hours until delivery.
Vancomycin 1 g every 12 hours until delivery.
Check sensitivities and start clindamycin 900 mg IV every 8 hours until delivery OR erythromycin 500 mg every 6 hours until delivery.

footnotes.footnote: Adapted from Morin CA, White K, Schuchat A, Danila RN, Lynfield R. Perinatal group B streptococcal disease prevention, Minnesota. Emerg Infect Dis. 2005;11:1467-9.
